market_summary: All six instruments are exhibiting late New York session consolidation with contracting volatility, low RVOL across the board, and price action hovering either near fair-value magnets (GBPUSD POC) or compressing mid-channel above daily session lows (XAUUSD, EURUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD). With institutional participation tapering into the NY close, disciplined execution favors holding cash across the entire portfolio.
